title: Make visual-taxonomy the one engine catalog
acceptance: Living Flame and night streaks are catalog entries; entries carry listed and composer flags.
Workshop reads the catalog instead of its own list.
A test fails if a module outside the catalog lists engine ids.
The catalog's Composer view equals RISE_CURRENT_VISUALS, checked in that direction only.

evidence.note: Part 1: Workshop and cortex lists derived from visual-registry.js; each derived list holds the same engines as the list it replaces.
Fails on three or more registered engine ids written as a list outside the named files.
Part 2: ENGINE_CATALOG with Living Flame and night streaks, listed and composer flags, the one-way Composer-view test; no visible change.

activity.summary: Seeded from Package B3 after the owner decisions.
Part 1 opened as #419: Workshop and cortex read the registry; guard test added.
Part 2 opened as #463; done on merge.

summary: Visual-registry is the one engine catalog: Workshop and cortex read it (#419), Living Flame and night streaks are entries, and every entry carries listed and composer flags; the Composer view equals RISE_CURRENT_VISUALS (#463).
